actions.title: Move the front wipers to the service position
actions.instruction: Within 20 seconds after switching the engine off, hold the wiper control in the MIST position for about 2 seconds until the wiper arms move to the top service position.

actions.title: Lift the wiper arm from the windshield
actions.instruction: Lift the wiper arm only after the blades are in the top service position.
actions.warning_text: Do not lift the wiper arms when they are parked normally; the arms can contact and damage the hood.

actions.title: Release the blade locking clip
actions.instruction: Open or press the blade connector locking clip as shown in the owner manual to release the blade from the arm.

actions.title: Remove the old wiper blade
actions.instruction: Slide the released wiper blade off the arm while supporting the arm.

actions.title: Install and lock the replacement blade
actions.instruction: Slide the correct replacement blade into the arm connector and lock it securely.

actions.title: Lower the arm and return the wipers to the park position
actions.instruction: Lower the wiper arm carefully onto the windshield, then operate the wipers so they return to their normal parked position.
actions.warning_text: Do not let the bare wiper arm snap against the windshield.
